repairs.description: Run the released score-generation and statistical entrypoints locally on the assigned worker rather than through SLURM; do not bind a physical GPU index.
Serialize the repository's released relative-power calculation from results.pkl into a deterministic JSON artifact without changing its formula.

If the OpenOOD Google Drive data bundle is temporarily quota-limited, stage the identical CIFAR-10 and DTD image populations from their public upstream archives into the OpenOOD imglist layout. The sample identities and benchmark imglist must remain unchanged.
